senses.gloss: m.Gimmel, third letter of the Alphabet; numerical value, three.
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 104a:4">Sabb. 104ᵃ</cite> (childrens’ mnemonical play) <he>גי׳ דל״ת גֹמול דֹלים</he> (Ms. M. <he>גמל</he>) Gimmel-Daleth intimates, Do good to the poor.
<cite ref="Shabbat 104a:4">Ib.</cite> <he>כרעיה דג׳</he> the foot of the Gimmel; a. fr.—Pl. <cite ref="C01049"><he>גִּמְלִין</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Shabbat 103b">Ib. 103ᵇ</cite> one must not write … <he>ג׳ צדין וכ׳</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>גַּמִּין</he>) Gimmels so as to be possibly taken for Tsaddes.
